title: E-commerce growth for a sports equipment brand
metaTitle: E-commerce Case Study: ₹0 to ₹1.5 Cr in 110 Days, No Paid Ads | GrowwStack
metaDescription: How GrowwStack built an end-to-end e-commerce operating layer for a sports equipment brand, growing revenue from ₹0 to ₹1.5 crore in 110 days with no paid ads.
headline: An operating layer across discovery, checkout and follow-up.
summary: A sports equipment brand with product-market fit but a storefront that leaked revenue at every step. We rebuilt the path from product discovery through checkout, customer conversation, fulfilment and the reporting behind each decision. The growth was purely organic: no paid ads were used.

headlineMetric.label: Revenue from ₹0 in 110 days · no paid ads

problem: Traffic arrived but converted inconsistently, with no reliable view of where it dropped off.
Customer conversations lived in personal inboxes and phones rather than a system anyone could pick up.
Order operations, payments and support were handled reactively, so growth added workload instead of margin.
systems: Payments, order operations, and customer support
approach: Fixed the storefront first — positioning, product presentation and the checkout path — so the brand's existing organic traffic converted better. No money was spent on paid ads.
Instrumented the funnel with analytics so every later decision was based on where visitors actually dropped, not assumptions.
Moved buyer conversations into WhatsApp workflows connected to a CRM, so follow-ups happened on time and nothing depended on someone remembering.
Connected payments, order operations and support so fulfilment held up as volume grew.
outcome: The partnership grew from ₹0 to ₹1.5 crore in e-commerce revenue in 110 days, purely organically and without any paid ads.
relatedNote: This engagement runs on the same terms as every GrowwStack partnership: no upfront agency fee, with the work judged on commercial movement.

title: Patient acquisition systems for a healthcare practice
metaTitle: Healthcare Marketing Case Study — Clinic Patient Acquisition | GrowwStack
metaDescription: How GrowwStack built a connected patient acquisition system for a healthcare practice, turning digital discovery into booked appointments and measurable growth.
headline: Turning digital discovery into booked appointments.
summary: Clinics rarely have a demand problem so much as a follow-through problem. We built a connected system that carries a patient from first search to a booked appointment, then makes sure the follow-up actually happens.
problem: Enquiries arrived across calls, messages and forms with no single place they were recorded.
Follow-up depended on whoever happened to be at the front desk that day.
There was no way to tell which channels produced booked appointments rather than just enquiries.
approach: Built the site around the decision a patient is actually making, so the path to booking is short and obvious.
Routed every enquiry — whatever channel it arrived through — into one CRM with appointment tracking attached.
Defined follow-up sequences so a missed call becomes a scheduled callback rather than a lost patient.
Improved digital visibility so the practice is found at the moment someone is searching for care.
outcome: The practice now works from a single view of enquiries and appointments, with follow-up running as a defined process rather than an individual's memory. It is one of the three partnerships behind ₹1.5 crore generated organically, with no paid ads, in three months.
relatedNote: Healthcare work is handled with the discretion the sector requires. Patient data stays inside the clinic's own systems.

title: B2B expansion for a deep technology manufacturer
metaTitle: Deep Tech B2B Case Study — Technical Business Expansion | GrowwStack
metaDescription: How GrowwStack turned complex refrigeration and deep-technology products into qualified commercial conversations through clear positioning and B2B systems.
headline: Complex products, translated into commercial conversations.
summary: Deep technology companies lose deals to explanation, not engineering. We built the positioning and B2B infrastructure that turns a genuinely difficult product into a conversation a buyer can act on.
problem: The engineering was strong, but the public explanation of it assumed the reader already understood the field.
Buying decisions involve several people, and nothing on the site spoke to the non-technical ones.
Lead generation depended on the founder's network rather than a repeatable process.
approach: Rewrote the product story so the commercial value is legible before the technical detail arrives, without diluting the engineering.
Built a technical website that serves both the specialist evaluating specifications and the manager approving the spend.
Set up B2B lead generation so qualified enquiries arrive through a process rather than through personal contacts.
Connected sales and business-development systems so long, multi-touch deal cycles are tracked rather than remembered.
outcome: Technical capability is now expressed in terms a commercial buyer can evaluate, supported by systems built for long B2B cycles. This is one of three active partnerships behind ₹1.5 crore generated organically, with no paid ads, in three months.
relatedNote: Founder experience spans Ecozen Solutions and Dover Corporation in refrigeration, thermal systems and product development.
